source: HM Treasury, Charter for Budget Responsibility (autumn 2024); OBR assessments since the October 2024 Budget
target_note: Both rules are assessed in 2029-30 until it becomes the third year of the forecast, then in the third year (rolling). Since the November 2025 Budget the OBR formally assesses the rules once a year, at the Budget.

rules.name: Stability rule
rules.description: Current budget (receipts less day-to-day spending, including debt interest) in balance or surplus in the target year. Headroom = current budget surplus, £bn.

rules.name: Investment rule
rules.description: Public sector net financial liabilities falling as a share of GDP in the target year. Headroom = fall in the ratio, shown in £bn at that year's GDP.

issuance_mix.note: Assumed split of gross financing (a typical recent DMO remit); edit to match the current remit.

synthetic_register.note: Used until a DMO gilts-in-issue (D1A) file is uploaded. Shares and maturities are approximate published DMO aggregates; coupons are calibrated to the interest the ONS records.

apf.note: OBR March 2026 assumption: £65bn a year reduction in the APF (redemptions plus £32bn of active sales).

extension.note: Years after the OBR horizon: real growth, GDP deflator and primary balance held at the OBR's final year; rates from the market curves.

cyclical.note: Semi-elasticity of the primary balance to the output gap (OBR cyclical adjustment is about 0.5–0.6) and output-gap persistence.
